verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents TypeScript inference only inside script blocks: defineProps and emit typing in <script setup>. Nothing shows compile-time type checking of template expressions; the 'Tooling Guide' entry is a bare title with no content. Template type checking is a fair axis for a UI framework, so the absence of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get compile-time type checking inside my component templates, not just script blocks
